name: High Tide
storyline:
Doug and Marcus arrive for exactly the reasons you would expect. Drink, smoke some weed, meet people, enjoy Kavuki Fest and probably make a few questionable decisions.

Then Doug agrees to help someone with something that should probably have been left alone. A cursed treasure is opened. Something is released across the island. Suddenly everyone is gone.

Now Doug has to leave the party behind, follow the curse, figure out what the hell happened and somehow bring everyone back before things get even worse.
summary: A story-driven adventure where Doug accidentally unleashes an ancient curse across a tropical island. Explore, solve environmental puzzles, battle corrupted creatures, help strange locals, and uncover how to bring the missing people back.
